summary.text: Bill Sutton is a Republican state representative who has represented Kansas House District 43 since 2013 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026. He chairs the Insurance Committee and has worked for Steel & Pipe Supply.

paragraphs.text: Sutton was born in Kansas City, Kansas, and as of February 2020 lived in Gardner, Kansas.
His career experience includes working with Steel & Pipe Supply.
Sutton took office in the Kansas House on January 14, 2013.

During the 2025-2026 session he served on the Appropriations, Commerce, Labor and Economic Development, Elections, and Administrative Rules and Regulations committees and the Robert G. (Bob) Bethell Joint Committee on Home and Community Based Services and KanCare Oversight, and chaired the Insurance Committee.
Ballotpedia lists him as married to Lana, with three children, and as a member of the Knights of Columbus who reached the rank of Grand Knight.
